weather_report:
Subiaco wakes under a rinsed blue sky, the kind that makes the edges of buildings look freshly sharpened. At midmorning the air is cool and clean, shadows still a touch long, and the sun already brightening into a steady companion. Expect the day to stay crystal clear through lunch and beyond, with the light growing kinder and warmer without ever turning harsh. UV will climb to moderate around midday, so a dab of sunscreen and sunglasses are wise if you linger outdoors.

It’s a pleasant, easy day for light layers: a soft sweater or long sleeves over something you can shed by noon, with a hat in your bag just in case. The weather invites simple errands on foot, a quiet coffee at a sunlit table, a slow wander to pick up groceries, or a few small jobs in the garden. Laundry will dry well on the line; a book will open itself in a patch of sun. By afternoon the sky should remain spotless, the air clear and unhurried, the sort of day that rewards unambitious plans and an unhurried stride.
